note: The two sets are nearly identical in values, bindings and quotes; the only difference is that Set B adds the condition 'S-301' to the 3/8" through bolt claim, which is supported since both through-bolt callouts sit in details keyed to S-301 (C1 S-301 and A4 S-301). Both sets read the dimension values correctly and keep left/right and top/bottom segment conditions where used. Both also share the same weaknesses: vague entities ('right-side component', 'dimension', truncated 'MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH'), repeated facts (7'-0" and 12'-3 3/4" each stated twice, 1 1/2" left side given under two entity names), and many page dimensions left unextracted. Set B's added, correct condition gives it a slight edge.
remarks: Both sets bind many dimensions to placeholder entities ('right-side component', 'dimension') rather than to the actual members/details shown (MODULE A and MODULE B PV structural members, details C1 S-301 and A4 S-301, L3X3X1/4 angles, 3/8" through bolts). Numerous dimensions on the page (3'-8 3/8", 3'-1 5/16", 2'-2 7/8", 6 3/16", 1'-8 11/16", 2'-3 7/8", 6 13/16", 1'-11 1/8", 2'-5 5/16", 4 3/4", 3", 2", 6") are extracted by neither set. The text layer garbles the detail titles as 'DULE B/A - PV STRUCTURAL MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH' (MODULE truncated), which likely caused the truncated entity name in both sets.
